entries.speaker: Patrolman in Lab Coat
entries.en: Those guises... You aren't among those[n]who desire salvation.

entries.speaker: Patrolman in Lab Coat
entries.en: Do not disturb our lord's research—[n]this world's salvation.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The language of a Shadow is a hint into[n]its Ruler's ideology... This one sounds[n]rather cultish, for example.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sorry, but we're going to pass through[n]there now. We don't have the time[n]to waste on peons like yourself.

entries.speaker: Patrolman in Lab Coat
entries.en: Why do you willingly strive for[n]self-suffering?

entries.speaker: Patrolman in Lab Coat
entries.en: Why are you reaching out to your[n]own pain?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It'll be too much trouble to go about this[n]haphazardly. I'll provide the support.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Look at this scum pile up.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Fine by me... Time for a bloodbath!
